item.title: Pigeonhole 1.5.0
item.description: • Your pinned tabs are now the same in Chrome and Edge and on your other Macs: pin, unpin or reorder one anywhere and it follows everywhere. The first time your browsers meet, their pinned tabs are combined, so none are lost. A browser's own pages (its settings, its extensions) stay pinned only in that browser. Setting up the extension is easier too: Settings › Browsers has Open Extensions, Show Folder and Copy Path, with how to find the folder with ⌘⇧G.
